reason: Adopt the audit-narrowed ceiling. The frozen-rule negative is valid and reproduced (BLIND_FAILS at tau*=0.6: SELECT FA 0.0/slack 0.1, G3 reincluded FA 0.0/COV 0.10/UP_excl 0.3571/selective 0.0 vs gold gate-met on identical rows; all controls, tripwires, split-disjointness and blindness bars verified), and blind resolution quality near zero across all nine feasible taus (SELECT selective 0.0; TEST selective 0.0-0.133 at permuted levels) hardens the parent ceiling as mandated. But the producer's broader ceiling fails: audit recomputation shows tau=0.3333 (FA exactly 0.10/COV 0.925/UP 0.8571/selective 0.054, knife-edge on two bars) passes the unchanged gate, so calibration-robust gate-incapability is not established and the tie-break confound is not closed; the max-slack higher-tau rule systematically selects the most abstention-heavy feasible tau (FA non-increasing in tau, tops at 0.6), so its coverage/UP collapse is a rule property. The outcome was entailed at freeze (parent post hoc plus monotonicity plus deterministic emission), yielding near-zero expected information gain despite genuine new per-tau raw vectors. With audit REVISE, VALIDATED (needs PASS) and PRODUCT_CORE (needs Product lane plus PASS plus promotion) are unavailable; global REJECTED would exceed the bounded evidence. Hence retain HYPOTHESIS, promote nothing, and route the single surviving knife-edge calibration (0.3333) plus the untested held-out-axis/coverage-constrained rule family as the next mandated question.
